ms.report:
Dear Reviewers, please find attached our Milestone 1 Proof of Achievement.
EVIDENCE
Our M1 detailed report is located here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1wcb7CeZZH13m1aJZfWhpMbBEOoD47Yxr/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=115944351836306387899&rtpof=true&sd=true
You will also be able to find all the evidence produced and collected in the following folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dh7LNdRoqwAG8C1Tj8psHa48PSMUW2k3?usp=sharing
The main report has the evidence of 4 TownHalls and 4 X Twitter Spaces = 8 TOTAL, held during January, February and March 2025. (We anticipated the first townhall and held it in January in a special edition on the Cardano hardfork on January 29th.)
In that report you will find all the youtube links to the recordings of our TownHalls and the X links for the recordings of our Spaces.
The posts and flyers realized to promote all the events can be found here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HvnLFTn6asjTPzrkE7_aNtvWEbt--gBW?usp=sharing
The PDFs and materials for each TownHall here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ikMjJ7E0WgBLZqlXq93V9j24hUZyDDnN?usp=sharing
A total of 1.768 Attendees or Viewers were present or viewed our TownHalls and Spaces recorded. A detailed report of Individual attendees numbers can be found here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VfpCXvnXwUAv29gpvXAh_QpZ531s-ofPznwH5Nv3r2c/edit?usp=sharing
PS: 
Translation of the Catalyst Global TH - The global Catalyst townhalls have been suspended since January and should resume soon, we are awaiting an official announcement. After that, we will translate the material into Portuguese and Spanish as usual.
